label: preparing
what: A coordinated hall hospitality/food effort: arranging and delivering bread (reported as 201 loaves) for the evening great-hall gathering/committee. The innkeeper identified the hospitality committee as builder, freight, and innkeeper; the baker baked/provided the bread and coordinated an exchange of grain for builder's spare planks and lanterns. Neighbour observed the teamwork and offered baking help, but direct evidence does not establish the neighbour as a knowing participant in the committee or bread preparation. The stated purpose was committee hospitality, though what the gathering will discuss remains unspecified.
